A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development and progression of EAE are accompanied by a decrease of the inhibitory activity of NOS and an increase of the expression of protein 4-NT in brain, while the reversal of the signs of the disease is associated with a normalization of the activity and inhibition of NOS.

the EAE model is a valuable tool to explore mechanisms of neurodegenerative diseases and the effects of drugs on the nervous system.
